pages.title: Be Inspired!
pages.description: Be Inspired! - Young Irish People Changing the World; Meet the inspiring young Irish people taking on the world! Award-winning author of Blazing a Trail and Dare to Dream, Sarah Webb interviews inspiring young Irish people about their amazing achievements.  It’s never too early to achieve your dreams – why not start today?
